title: Hashima HP-84A
subtitle: Fully Automatic Heat-Transfer Press

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Hashima HP-84A is a fully automatic heat-transfer / fusing press used in garment assembly for bonding interlining to outer fabric. Heated aluminum plates apply uniform temperature and pressure. Motor-driven — no air compressor required.
applications: Interlining bonding for medium-weight woven garments

overviewDescription: Made by Hashima Co., Ltd. (Japan). The HP-84A is the predecessor to the current Hashima HP-84N family. Still in distribution via official channels (e.g., IIGM Bangalore) but no longer featured in Hashima's own current product page. Modern successor HP-84N has updated heater wattage and control panel.

technicalSpecs.value: Pneumatic or electric; modern variant requires no air compressor
Dial control of pressure, temperature, time
